visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young man, Brian, wearing a black t-shirt. He lifts the shirt to reveal his abdomen. Another man, the main creator 77 Boss, has his hand resting on Brian's shoulder. A large graphic sunburst with the text '77老大 理毛初體驗' dominates the center. The setting is a bright studio with a grey wall and white ceiling fixtures. (2) A transition cut shows Brian and 77 Boss on a grey sofa. 77 Boss is leaning over Brian, gesturing toward his lap. Brian is looking down with a focused expression. A small animated cartoon character appears as a visual overlay next to 77 Boss. The lighting remains bright and even. (3) The camera cuts to a close-up of a sponge covered in dark hair fibers held by 77 Boss. His eyes are wide in a dramatic, humorous expression. Yellow text overlays '完全不用雷射' appear at the bottom. The background is a slightly blurred office or studio setting. (4) Back on the sofa, Brian pulls his waistband forward to look inside his shorts. 77 Boss laughs, covering his mouth. Pink floral graphics and a variety caption '(不忍直視)' appear around them. Brian wears a surprised and amused expression. (5) 77 Boss is now in a bathroom setting, shirtless with a white bathrobe draped over his left shoulder. He holds two white product tubes from the brand 'Relove'. He looks directly at the camera with an authoritative and professional demeanor. A graphic list with bullet points appears on the right side of the frame explaining product features. (6) A series of close-up shots show the product being applied to a leg. 77 Boss's hand rubs a white cream onto Brian's hairy shin. Brian is wearing denim shorts. The camera angle is low, focusing on the leg and the application process. (7) Final scene features 77 Boss and Brian together again on the sofa. They are both smiling and looking at the camera. 77 Boss holds the product tube toward the viewer. A final sunburst graphic with brand text appears before the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp 'shink' sound effect plays as the title card appears. 77 Boss begins speaking in a high-arousal, energetic Mandarin tone. Upbeat electronic pop music with a prominent synthesized drum beat starts at 126 BPM. The vocal delivery is fast with very few pauses. (2) A 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition. Brian's voice enters with a lighter, slightly higher pitch, expressing surprise. A comedic 'boing' SFX plays during a humorous interaction. BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) A 'ding' SFX sounds as product benefits appear on screen. 77 Boss shifts his tone to a slightly more professional, narrative style while maintaining high energy. The music ducks slightly in volume to prioritize the vocal clarity. (4) Laughter track SFX is briefly mixed in. Multiple rapid 'pop' sound effects occur during a sequence of quick cuts showing product application. The master track is clean with studio-grade clarity and high spectral brightness. (5) A final stinger SFX plays at the very end of the video as 77 Boss delivers a concluding slogan. The BGM fades out sharply with a final percussive hit.
